title: Deficiency in Service
description: Deficiency means any fault, imperfection, shortcoming or inadequacy in the quality, nature and manner of performance which is required to be maintained by or under any law for the time being in force or has been undertaken to be performed by a person in pursuance of a contract or otherwise in relation to any service.

title: Unfair Trade Practice
description: A trade practice which, for the purpose of promoting the sale, use or supply of any goods or for the provision of any service, adopts any unfair method or unfair or deceptive practice including falsely representing goods to be of a particular standard, quality, quantity, grade, composition, style or model, or refusing to take back defective goods or refund the amount paid within the stipulated period.
applicable_situations: refusal to refund for defective goods

title: Product Liability
description: The responsibility of a product manufacturer or product seller, of any product or service, to compensate for any harm caused to a consumer by such defective product manufactured or sold or by deficiency in services relating thereto.
applicable_situations: physical injury caused by defective product
property damage caused by malfunctioning appliance

title: Jurisdiction of District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
description: A complaint in relation to goods or services where the value of the goods or services paid as consideration does not exceed fifty lakh rupees (₹50,00,000) may be instituted in the District Commission within the local limits of whose jurisdiction the complainant resides or personally works for gain, or where the opposite party resides or carries on business, or where the cause of action arises.
applicable_situations: filing complaint for claim value <= 50 lakhs
filing at complainant's local district commission

title: Jurisdiction of State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
description: Complaints where the value of goods or services paid as consideration exceeds fifty lakh rupees (₹50,00,000) but does not exceed two crore rupees (₹2,00,00,000).
applicable_situations: claim value between 50 lakhs and 2 crores

title: Jurisdiction of National Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
description: Complaints where the value of goods or services paid as consideration exceeds two crore rupees (₹2,00,00,000).

title: Limitation Period for Consumer Complaints
description: The District Commission, the State Commission or the National Commission shall not admit a complaint unless it is filed within two (2) years from the date on which the cause of action has arisen.
